say:1:1330239001:1.text: Old festivals? Hmm... pretty much the same.
say:1:1330239001:1.source_cn: 以前的祭典？嗯……和现在差不多，没什么区别。
say:1:1330239001:1.male: Old festivals? Hmm... pretty much the same.
say:1:1330239001:1.female: Old festivals? Hmm... pretty much the same.

say:2:1330239002:1.text: But my legs didn't get sore back then... I'd do every festival activity without getting tired, no matter how much I ran.
say:2:1330239002:1.source_cn: 但是年轻时候的我腿可不疼……那时我会把祭典的活动都玩一...
say:2:1330239002:1.male: But my legs didn't get sore back then... I'd do every festival activity without getting tired, no matter how much I ran.
say:2:1330239002:1.female: But my legs didn't get sore back then... I'd do every festival activity without getting tired, no matter how much I ran.
